description: Sankey Plume shows how amounts move: from a source to a destination, from one stage to the next, or from one period to the next. Use it like the Microsoft Sankey (Source, Destination, Weight), with one field per column, or follow each customer or product over time to see who stays, upgrades, downgrades, arrives or leaves. Free features, no watermark Source and Destination: a name found on both sides is a single node, so flows go on over several levels; cycles are drawn as loops, or use two columns. Stages and time: one column per field, or Category + Period + Individual with New and Lost nodes. Stable order: a category keeps its place and color in every column; automatic order with fewer crossings, alphabetical, data or custom order: drag a node in edit mode. Labels in values or percentages: share of the column or of the starting total, conversion rate on each flow, Others beyond a maximum. Flow colors: origin, destination, neutral, or a measure such as a margin or bounce rate; adjustable opacity, also for dimmed flows. Interact: hover traces every path through a category, click a node or a flow to cross-filter (time mode: the individuals of that flow), cross-highlighting, tooltip fields, right-click menu, keyboard.
